recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is; the current source satisfies FHIR-7765, and editing would only restate or polish existing guidance without changing implementer understanding.
issue_request: FHIR-7765 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution asking to harmonize AllergyIntolerance.event, Contraindication, and Immunization.reaction by adding an Immunization.reaction usage note and updating Contraindication and AllergyIntolerance relationship guidance.
initial_application: The request was applied by 2015 commits: 67f5883885 added the Immunization.reaction comment, b6b2159d66 added Immunization and AllergyIntolerance narrative, and the same-period FHIR-8043 rename path (1408563d74 plus cc54b56e72) carried Contraindication references forward to DetectedIssue.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists AllergyIntolerance, DetectedIssue, and Immunization as active resources and records Contraindication as having become DetectedIssue. Later FHIR-15124 rejected replacing Immunization.reaction guidance with AdverseEvent guidance, and commit 0edb306a7 restored the AllergyIntolerance-focused wording. The combined branch already contains a separate FHIR-8043 audit commit.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. The current Immunization StructureDefinition and narrative contain the reaction-to-AllergyIntolerance note; AllergyIntolerance narrative contains the reciprocal note and points event-specific alerts to DetectedIssue; DetectedIssue narrative describes its boundary from general propensity-to-risk records such as AllergyIntolerance.

related_jiras.note: Renamed Contraindication to DetectedIssue, which determines how the Contraindication part of FHIR-7765 maps to current source; already audited on the combined branch.
Later No Change decision rejected AdverseEvent replacement guidance and supports retaining Immunization.reaction as the place for reaction documentation.
